input: Arrange airport transfers for my parents' visit

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this covers arrival only, departure only, or both legs determines how many bookings need to be made and what needs to be coordinated.
The specific airport, dates, and flight times are the foundation of any booking — without them, no transfer can actually be arranged.
The number of passengers and amount of luggage directly affects which vehicle type or service tier is needed.
A defined budget determines whether to look at private car services, ride-hailing apps, shared shuttles, or public transport options.
Parents may have mobility issues, comfort preferences, or familiarity with certain services, which changes the type of transfer that is appropriate.
Whether the user wants to drive the parents themselves, book a third-party service, or have someone else handle it changes the entire action plan.
Knowing what a successful transfer looks like — e.g. door-to-door, meet-and-greet with a sign, tracking updates — sets the standard for choosing the right option.

gold.taskTitle: Arrange airport transfers for parents' visit
gold.taskDescription: Organise reliable transport to and from the airport for the user's parents during their upcoming visit.

questions.title: Which direction(s) need a transfer — arrival, departure, or both?
questions.description: Clarify whether one or two transfer legs need to be booked to determine the full scope of the task.

questions.title: Which airport, and what are the flight dates and times?
questions.description: Capture the specific airport name and the exact arrival and/or departure times to make any booking actionable.

questions.title: How many people are travelling and how much luggage?
questions.description: Determine the passenger count and baggage volume so the right vehicle size can be selected.

questions.title: What is the budget per transfer, roughly?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to filter options between private hire, ride-hailing, shared shuttle, or public transport.

questions.title: Do your parents have any mobility, comfort, or language needs?
questions.description: Identify any special requirements such as wheelchair access, a non-English-speaking driver, or a preference for a quieter, comfortable ride.

questions.title: Will you drive them yourself or book an external service?
questions.description: Determine whether this task involves personal logistics or researching and booking a third-party transfer provider.

questions.title: What does a successful transfer look like to you — door-to-door, meet-and-greet, live tracking?
questions.description: Define the quality and service level expected so the best-fit option can be identified and confirmed.
